from decimal import Decimal, ROUND_HALF_UP


def tax(amount, rate):
    """Tax on an invoice amount, to the cent.

    Rounded half up to the cent per finance policy FIN-12.
    """
    exact = Decimal(str(amount)) * Decimal(str(rate))
    rounded = exact.quantize(Decimal("0.01"), rounding=ROUND_HALF_UP)
    return float(rounded)

    """

    rounded = exact.quantize(Decimal("0.01"), rounding=ROUND_HALF_UP)
    return float(rounded)
